feature_set: V6 combined, 38 raw dimensions, native missing values; no V7 speed feature
sample_weight: 1 / number of active runners in that race; no positive-class reweighting
probabilities: Softmax of raw binary-logit margins among active runners (normalized odds); non-runners exactly zero. No fitted temperature or calibration.
selection: One fixed configuration; no early stopping, grid search or retuning after results
limits: Binary training objective differs from race conditional log loss
Normalized odds do not establish calibration
